jp: 外敵に会ったりつつかれたりすると、身体から強烈な酸性の液を噴出して身を守ろうとする。その酸攻撃で余計な怒りを買って殺されてしまうことも多い。
jp_grezzo: "外敵に会ったりつつかれたりすると、身体から強烈な酸性の液を噴出して身を守ろうとする。その酸攻撃で余計な怒りを買って殺されてしまうことも多い。"
en: When meeting or being poked by an outside enemy the body spurts out an intense acidic liquid to protect itself. That acid attack often causes extra anger and gets them killed.
en_grezzo: "When meeting or being poked by an outside enemy the body spurts out an intense acidic liquid to protect itself. That acid attack often causes extra anger and gets them killed."
it: Quando incontra un nemico o si sente beccare, si difende schizzando dal corpo un liquido acido violentissimo. Spesso però quell'attacco non fa che aumentare la rabbia di chi ha davanti, e allora finisce ammazzata.

jp: 魔力を蓄えた珍しいかたつむり。かたつむりのくせに魔法をそれなりに使うことができる。これなら野生でも生き残れる…と思いきや、食べると魔法に強くなれる性質があるため食用にされることが多い。
jp_grezzo: "魔力を蓄えた珍しいかたつむり。かたつむりのくせに魔法をそれなりに使うことができる。これなら野生でも生き残れる…と思いきや、食べると魔法に強くなれる性質があるため食用にされることが多い。"
en: A rare snail that has accumulated magical power. Even though it is a snail it is able to use magic in its own way. It is often eaten because of its magical properties that make it stronger when eaten.
en_grezzo: "A rare snail that has accumulated magical power. Even though it is a snail it is able to use magic in its own way. It is often eaten because of its magical properties that make it stronger when eaten."
it: Una chiocciola rara che ha accumulato dentro di sé potere magico. Per essere una chiocciola, la magia sa pure usarla in modo dignitoso. Verrebbe da dire che allo stato brado se la cavi... e invece no: chi la mangia diventa più forte nella magia, e per questo finisce spesso in pentola.

jp: 海のかたつむり。殻は退化して体の中に内蔵されている。食べられないことはないが、そのままでは味がほとんどない上に毒がある。海水には適応しているが、濃い塩を浴びるとやはり助からない。
jp_grezzo: "海のかたつむり。殻は退化して体の中に内蔵されている。食べられないことはないが、そのままでは味がほとんどない上に毒がある。海水には適応しているが、濃い塩を浴びるとやはり助からない。"
en: The snail of the sea. The shell has degenerated and is housed in the body. It's never eaten but it has almost no flavor as it is and is poisonous. It is adaptable to seawater but it does not help if it is exposed to thick salt.
en_grezzo: "The snail of the sea. The shell has degenerated and is housed in the body. It's never eaten but it has almost no flavor as it is and is poisonous. It is adaptable to seawater but it does not help if it is exposed to thick salt."
it: La chiocciola del mare. Il guscio le si è ridotto e le è finito dentro il corpo. Mangiarla non è impossibile, ma così com'è non sa quasi di niente ed è pure velenosa. All'acqua salata si è adattata, però se le si rovescia addosso del sale forte non la salva nessuno.

jp: スライムの一種を用い、少女の死体をつなぎ合わせて作られた。生前の記憶を求めて現文明以前から彷徨っている。その完成度は芸術品レベルであり、量産型のゾンビなどとは比較にならない力を持つ。
jp_grezzo: "スライムの一種を用い、少女の死体をつなぎ合わせて作られた。生前の記憶を求めて現文明以前から彷徨っている。その完成度は芸術品レベルであり、量産型のゾンビなどとは比較にならない力を持つ。"
en: Using a type of slime it was created by piecing together the corpse of a girl. She has been wandering around since before the present civilization in search of memories of her past. Its perfection is a work of art level with powers that cannot be compared to mass-produced zombies.
en_grezzo: "Using a type of slime it was created by piecing together the corpse of a girl. She has been wandering around since before the present civilization in search of memories of her past. Its perfection is a work of art level with powers that cannot be compared to mass-produced zombies."
it: È nata cucendo insieme il cadavere di una ragazza con l'aiuto di una specie di melma. Da prima dell'attuale civiltà vaga in cerca dei ricordi di quando era viva. La fattura è di livello artistico, e ha una forza che gli zombi di serie non le si avvicinano nemmeno.

jp: スライムの一種を用い、少女の死体をつなぎ合わせて作られた。生前のままの自我をもつ。製造の際に歪んだ食欲を植え付けられており、ゾンビだろうが人だろうが意思とは裏腹に本能的に捕食してしまう。
jp_grezzo: "スライムの一種を用い、少女の死体をつなぎ合わせて作られた。生前のままの自我をもつ。製造の際に歪んだ食欲を植え付けられており、ゾンビだろうが人だろうが意思とは裏腹に本能的に捕食してしまう。"
en: Using a type of slime it was created by piecing together the corpse of a girl. It has the ego as it was when it was alive. They have been instilled with a distorted appetite during manufacturing and instinctively prey on zombies or people against their will.
en_grezzo: "Using a type of slime it was created by piecing together the corpse of a girl. It has the ego as it was when it was alive. They have been instilled with a distorted appetite during manufacturing and instinctively prey on zombies or people against their will."
it: È nata cucendo insieme il cadavere di una ragazza con l'aiuto di una specie di melma. Ha ancora l'io che aveva da viva. Mentre la fabbricavano le hanno innestato un appetito storto, e così, zombi o persone che siano, se li divora d'istinto, contro la sua stessa volontà.

jp: スライムの一種を用い、少女の死体をつなぎ合わせて作られた。生前の少女の人格を持つが、心が狂気に蝕まれている。高い射撃能力を後天的に植え付けられたタイプであり、後方から地味に仕事をする。
jp_grezzo: "スライムの一種を用い、少女の死体をつなぎ合わせて作られた。生前の少女の人格を持つが、心が狂気に蝕まれている。高い射撃能力を後天的に植え付けられたタイプであり、後方から地味に仕事をする。"
en: Using a type of slime it was created by piecing together the corpse of a girl. She takes on the persona of a girl who was alive but her mind is consumed by madness. She is the type who was born with a high shooting ability and works calmly from the rear.
en_grezzo: "Using a type of slime it was created by piecing together the corpse of a girl. She takes on the persona of a girl who was alive but her mind is consumed by madness. She is the type who was born with a high shooting ability and works calmly from the rear."
it: È nato cucendo insieme il cadavere di una ragazza con l'aiuto di una specie di melma. Ha la personalità che la ragazza aveva da viva, ma la mente gliela rode la follia. È del tipo a cui la mira è stata innestata dopo, e lavora dalle retrovie, senza dare nell'occhio.

jp: 選りすぐりの人体パーツを用いて作られた、最強のサヴァント。簡易的にだがネクロマンシーを使用することもできる。エリートであることに誇りを持っているが、実際はただの当て馬であることを知らない。
jp_grezzo: "選りすぐりの人体パーツを用いて作られた、最強のサヴァント。簡易的にだがネクロマンシーを使用することもできる。エリートであることに誇りを持っているが、実際はただの当て馬であることを知らない。"
en: The strongest Savant made using a selection of human body parts. It can also use necromancy albeit briefly. It takes pride in being an elite but doesn't know that it's actually just a guessing horse.
en_grezzo: "The strongest Savant made using a selection of human body parts. It can also use necromancy albeit briefly. It takes pride in being an elite but doesn't know that it's actually just a guessing horse."
it: La savant più forte di tutte, fatta con pezzi di corpo umano scelti a uno a uno. Sa usare anche la negromanzia, se pure in forma rudimentale. Va fiera di essere fra le elette, e non sa che in realtà non è che un'esca.

jp: 伝説的なまでに勝利に飢えた狼。恐ろしく負けず嫌い。気を練ることで体を硬化させることができるが、これは巨大化の技をかなり間違えて習得した結果のようだ。
jp_grezzo: "伝説的なまでに勝利に飢えた狼。恐ろしく負けず嫌い。気を練ることで体を硬化させることができるが、これは巨大化の技をかなり間違えて習得した結果のようだ。"
en: A wolf with a legendary hunger for victory. He is a terrible loser. It is possible to harden the body by practicing chi but this seems to be the result of learning the giantization technique in a rather incorrect way.
en_grezzo: "A wolf with a legendary hunger for victory. He is a terrible loser. It is possible to harden the body by practicing chi but this seems to be the result of learning the giantization technique in a rather incorrect way."
it: Un lupo affamato di vittoria fino alla leggenda, e che a perdere non ci sta in modo spaventoso. Impastando il ki riesce a indurirsi il corpo, ma pare che sia il risultato di una tecnica di ingigantimento imparata parecchio male.

jp: 他人の心を覗き見、復讐心を食らって操る悪魔。内心は復讐を馬鹿らしく思っており、自身を封印した神々に対しても復讐は考えていない。誘いに乗らない者に出会うと興味を示し、執着する。
jp_grezzo: "他人の心を覗き見、復讐心を食らって操る悪魔。内心は復讐を馬鹿らしく思っており、自身を封印した神々に対しても復讐は考えていない。誘いに乗らない者に出会うと興味を示し、執着する。"
en: A demon that peers into the minds of others and manipulates them with a vengeful spirit. Deep down she thinks revenge is a fool's errand and she has no intention of taking revenge on the gods who sealed her. When she meets someone who doesn't take her up on her offer she shows interest and becomes obsessed.
en_grezzo: "A demon that peers into the minds of others and manipulates them with a vengeful spirit. Deep down she thinks revenge is a fool's errand and she has no intention of taking revenge on the gods who sealed her. When she meets someone who doesn't take her up on her offer she shows interest and becomes obsessed."
it: Un demone che sbircia nel cuore degli altri, si nutre della loro sete di vendetta e li manovra. Dentro di sé però la vendetta la trova una sciocchezza, e non ne medita nemmeno contro gli dei che l'hanno sigillata. Quando incontra qualcuno che non abbocca al suo invito si incuriosisce, e non lo molla più.

jp: 群れの中で殺し合う性質を持つ種類のカラス。そのなかで最後に生き残った一羽がこう呼ばれる。先天的に戦闘適正に優れており、ドミナントとも呼ばれる。
jp_grezzo: "群れの中で殺し合う性質を持つ種類のカラス。そのなかで最後に生き残った一羽がこう呼ばれる。先天的に戦闘適正に優れており、ドミナントとも呼ばれる。"
en: A type of crow that has the tendency to kill each other in flocks. The last one to survive is called this. They are also called the dominant because they have congenital combat skills.
en_grezzo: "A type of crow that has the tendency to kill each other in flocks. The last one to survive is called this. They are also called the dominant because they have congenital combat skills."
it: Una razza di corvi che dentro lo stormo si ammazzano fra loro. L'ultimo che resta vivo si chiama così. È portato per il combattimento fin dalla nascita, e lo chiamano anche il dominante.

jp: ペンギンのペンギンによるペンギンのための国を作るため旅をするペンギンの戦士。寒いところが好みなのだが、暑いところでも根性で活動する。飛ぶことができないが、泳ぐのは非常に上手い。
jp_grezzo: "ペンギンのペンギンによるペンギンのための国を作るため旅をするペンギンの戦士。寒いところが好みなのだが、暑いところでも根性で活動する。飛ぶことができないが、泳ぐのは非常に上手い。"
en: A penguin warrior who travels to make a country for penguins by penguins penguins. They prefer the cold but they will work with guts even in the heat. They can''t fly but they're very good swimmers.
en_grezzo: "A penguin warrior who travels to make a country for penguins by penguins penguins. They prefer the cold but they will work with guts even in the heat. They can''t fly but they're very good swimmers."
it: Un pinguino guerriero che viaggia per fondare un paese dei pinguini, dai pinguini, per i pinguini. Preferisce i posti freddi, ma anche al caldo tira avanti a forza di fegato. Volare non sa, ma nuotare sì, e benissimo.

jp: 王宮お抱えの魔法使い。才能の塊のような存在で、幼少の頃から膨大な魔力を自在に扱えた者も少なくない。有事の際には王宮の守護も行う。
jp_grezzo: "王宮お抱えの魔法使い。才能の塊のような存在で、幼少の頃から膨大な魔力を自在に扱えた者も少なくない。有事の際には王宮の守護も行う。"
en: He is a wizard at the royal palace. He is like a mass of talent and there are few who have been able to handle the enormous amount of magic at will since childhood. He is also the guardian of the royal palace in case of emergency.
en_grezzo: "He is a wizard at the royal palace. He is like a mass of talent and there are few who have been able to handle the enormous amount of magic at will since childhood. He is also the guardian of the royal palace in case of emergency."
it: Un mago al servizio della corte. Sono talento allo stato puro, e non pochi fra loro sapevano maneggiare a piacimento un potere magico immenso fin da bambini. Quando le cose si mettono male fanno anche da guardia al palazzo.

jp: 生まれつき魔法の才能に劣るエウダーナ兵。弓で戦闘力を補っている。魔法使いと見なされておらず、本国における扱いは最低クラス。そのため不満と嫉妬を抱えている。
jp_grezzo: "生まれつき魔法の才能に劣るエウダーナ兵。弓で戦闘力を補っている。魔法使いと見なされておらず、本国における扱いは最低クラス。そのため不満と嫉妬を抱えている。"
en: A soldier of Eulderna who was born with an inferior talent for magic. He supplemented his fighting power with a bow. He is not considered a wizard and his treatment in his home country is of the lowest class. Because of this he is frustrated and jealous.
en_grezzo: "A soldier of Eulderna who was born with an inferior talent for magic. He supplemented his fighting power with a bow. He is not considered a wizard and his treatment in his home country is of the lowest class. Because of this he is frustrated and jealous."
it: Un soldato di Eulderna nato con poco talento per la magia. Quel che gli manca lo colma con l'arco. In patria non lo considerano un mago e lo trattano da ultimo degli ultimi, e per questo si porta dentro rancore e invidia.

jp: 神々の大戦で散った天使の、力の欠片と名前を受け継ぐ熊。その名は「熊の神」を意味する。弩砲を使いこなすパワーを持つが魔法はてんで使えない。
jp_grezzo: "神々の大戦で散った天使の、力の欠片と名前を受け継ぐ熊。その名は「熊の神」を意味する。弩砲を使いこなすパワーを持つが魔法はてんで使えない。"
en: A bear that inherits a piece of power and a name from an angel that was scattered in the Great War of the Gods. Its name means God of the Bear. He has the power to use the crossbow but is completely incapable of using magic.
en_grezzo: "A bear that inherits a piece of power and a name from an angel that was scattered in the Great War of the Gods. Its name means God of the Bear. He has the power to use the crossbow but is completely incapable of using magic."
it: Un orso che ha ereditato il nome e una scheggia del potere di un angelo caduto nella grande guerra fra gli dei. Il suo nome vuol dire dio dell'orso. Ha la forza per maneggiare la balista come si deve, ma di magia non ne sa fare proprio.

jp: 闇喰コアラの群れを統率する最強の闇喰コアラ。餌場や襲撃場所を決定し、群れを導く役割を持つ。棒状のものを振り回したがる習性がある。お肌に気を使っているのか、サラサラのパウダーを使用しているようだ。
jp_grezzo: "闇喰コアラの群れを統率する最強の闇喰コアラ。餌場や襲撃場所を決定し、群れを導く役割を持つ。棒状のものを振り回したがる習性がある。お肌に気を使っているのか、サラサラのパウダーを使用しているようだ。"
en: The strongest dark-eating koala leads a herd of dark-eating koalas. They are responsible for deciding where to feed and raid and guiding the herd. It has a habit of swinging a stick-shaped object. They seem to care about their skin and use a silky powder.
en_grezzo: "The strongest dark-eating koala leads a herd of dark-eating koalas. They are responsible for deciding where to feed and raid and guiding the herd. It has a habit of swinging a stick-shaped object. They seem to care about their skin and use a silky powder."
it: Il koala mangiabuio più forte di tutti, quello che comanda il branco. Decide dove si mangia e dove si va all'assalto, e guida gli altri. Ha il vizio di sbracciare con qualunque cosa abbia la forma di un bastone. E pare che si serva di una polvere finissima: chissà, forse ci tiene alla pelle.

jp: 人の味を覚えてしまった大熊。人家周囲に積極的に現れるうえ、非常に執着心が強い。悪い神と見なされ太古の昔から人々に駆逐されてきた。
jp_grezzo: "人の味を覚えてしまった大熊。人家周囲に積極的に現れるうえ、非常に執着心が強い。悪い神と見なされ太古の昔から人々に駆逐されてきた。"
en: A big bear has learned a taste for people. They appear actively around people's houses and are extremely obsessive. They are considered evil gods and have been hunted down by the people since time immemorial.
en_grezzo: "A big bear has learned a taste for people. They appear actively around people's houses and are extremely obsessive. They are considered evil gods and have been hunted down by the people since time immemorial."
it: Un orso enorme che ha preso il gusto della carne umana. Si spinge fin sotto le case senza farsi problemi, e a una preda che ha scelto non rinuncia più. Lo si ritiene un dio malvagio, e dai tempi più antichi la gente gli dà la caccia per sterminarlo.

jp: 遺跡から発見された生体兵器。ボディの一部が機械や装甲に置き換えられた虎。獣の俊敏さを生かした連続突進を避けるのは困難。ぎらぎらと発光していることからその名がつけられたようだ。
jp_grezzo: "遺跡から発見された生体兵器。ボディの一部が機械や装甲に置き換えられた虎。獣の俊敏さを生かした連続突進を避けるのは困難。ぎらぎらと発光していることからその名がつけられたようだ。"
en: Bioweapons discovered in the ruins. A tiger whose body has been partially replaced by a machine or armor. It's hard to avoid continuous rushes with the agility of a beast. It seems to have been named after the glittering lights.
en_grezzo: "Bioweapons discovered in the ruins. A tiger whose body has been partially replaced by a machine or armor. It's hard to avoid continuous rushes with the agility of a beast. It seems to have been named after the glittering lights."
it: Un'arma biologica ritrovata fra le rovine: una tigre a cui hanno sostituito parte del corpo con macchine e corazze. Sfrutta l'agilità della belva per caricare a ripetizione, ed è difficile scansarla. Il nome pare che le venga da quel suo luccicare accecante.

jp: ライオンをベースとして呪術で生み出された合成獣。人並の知能…というより完全に人の知性を有しており、生み出される際にいったいどんなことが行われたのか気になるところである。
jp_grezzo: "ライオンをベースとして呪術で生み出された合成獣。人並の知能…というより完全に人の知性を有しており、生み出される際にいったいどんなことが行われたのか気になるところである。"
en: A synthetic beast based on a lion and spawned through magic. It has the intelligence of a human or rather the intelligence of a complete human and it is curious to know what was done when it was created.
en_grezzo: "A synthetic beast based on a lion and spawned through magic. It has the intelligence of a human or rather the intelligence of a complete human and it is curious to know what was done when it was created."
it: Una bestia sintetica generata con le arti maledette a partire da un leone. Ha un'intelligenza pari a quella di un uomo... anzi, ha proprio l'intelligenza di un uomo, e vien voglia di sapere che cosa sia successo davvero mentre la creavano.

jp: カーバンクルの亜種であり、より小型。しかし魔力は通常種よりも強く、様々なモンスターを召喚することができる。伝説上の生き物とされてきたが、今日ではその伝説の内容を知るものが一人もいない。
jp_grezzo: "カーバンクルの亜種であり、より小型。しかし魔力は通常種よりも強く、様々なモンスターを召喚することができる。伝説上の生き物とされてきたが、今日ではその伝説の内容を知るものが一人もいない。"
en: It is a subspecies of the carbuncle and is smaller. However its magic power is stronger than that of the normal species and it can summon a variety of monsters. It was once considered a fabled creature but today no one knows what the legend is.
en_grezzo: "It is a subspecies of the carbuncle and is smaller. However its magic power is stronger than that of the normal species and it can summon a variety of monsters. It was once considered a fabled creature but today no one knows what the legend is."
it: Una sottospecie del carbonchio, più minuta. Il potere magico però ce l'ha più forte di quella comune, e riesce a evocare mostri di ogni sorta. È sempre stato considerato una creatura da leggenda, ma oggi non c'è più nessuno che sappia dire che cosa raccontasse quella leggenda.

jp: 悪夢が羊の形をとったもの。逃げる羊を追いかけていくと、いつの間にか悪夢に迷い込んでいるという。もしも…あなたが夢の中でこの羊に会ってしまった場合、「決して目を合わせてはいけない」
jp_grezzo: "悪夢が羊の形をとったもの。逃げる羊を追いかけていくと、いつの間にか悪夢に迷い込んでいるという。もしも…あなたが夢の中でこの羊に会ってしまった場合、「決して目を合わせてはいけない」"
en: The nightmare took the form of a sheep. He chases a fleeing sheep but before he knows it he's lost in a nightmare. If...you have met this sheep in your dreams Never make eye contact.
en_grezzo: "The nightmare took the form of a sheep. He chases a fleeing sheep but before he knows it he's lost in a nightmare. If...you have met this sheep in your dreams Never make eye contact."
it: Un incubo che ha preso la forma di una pecora. Si dice che a inseguire la pecora che scappa ci si ritrovi smarriti dentro l'incubo senza nemmeno accorgersene. E se mai... se mai in sogno dovesse capitarti di incontrare questa pecora: non incrociare mai il suo sguardo.

jp: エウダーナで過剰なまでの魔術改造を施された黒い羊。可視光線を吸収し姿を消すことができる。透明化して敵に近づき生気を奪う。名前が示す通り、まさに外道。
jp_grezzo: "エウダーナで過剰なまでの魔術改造を施された黒い羊。可視光線を吸収し姿を消すことができる。透明化して敵に近づき生気を奪う。名前が示す通り、まさに外道。"
en: A black sheep that has been subjected to an excessive amount of magical modification in Eulderna. It can absorb visible light and disappear. They turn invisible and approach the enemy taking their life away. As the name implies it is truly an outsider.
en_grezzo: "A black sheep that has been subjected to an excessive amount of magical modification in Eulderna. It can absorb visible light and disappear. They turn invisible and approach the enemy taking their life away. As the name implies it is truly an outsider."
it: Una pecora nera su cui a Eulderna hanno accanito le modifiche magiche fino all'eccesso. Assorbe la luce visibile e sparisce alla vista. Si fa invisibile, si accosta al nemico e gli succhia via il soffio vitale. Come dice il nome, ha proprio smarrito la retta via.

jp: 迷える子羊が心身ともに成長し、迷いを乗り越えた姿。その瞳を覗き込めば、固い決意と覚悟に満ち溢れていることがわかるだろう。迷える子羊を優しく見守り、時には導く存在。
jp_grezzo: "迷える子羊が心身ともに成長し、迷いを乗り越えた姿。その瞳を覗き込めば、固い決意と覚悟に満ち溢れていることがわかるだろう。迷える子羊を優しく見守り、時には導く存在。"
en: A lost lamb grows up in mind and body and overcomes his hesitation. If you look into those eyes you can see that they are full of determination and resolve. He is a gentle watcher and sometimes a guide to the lost lamb.
en_grezzo: "A lost lamb grows up in mind and body and overcomes his hesitation. If you look into those eyes you can see that they are full of determination and resolve. He is a gentle watcher and sometimes a guide to the lost lamb."
it: È la pecorella smarrita che, cresciuta nel corpo e nell'animo, ha vinto lo smarrimento. Basta guardarlo negli occhi per accorgersi che è colmo di decisione e di fermezza. Veglia con dolcezza sulle pecorelle smarrite, e ogni tanto le guida.

jp: 羽の生えた魔力ある蛇神。割と小柄で、５ｍ程度しかない。体から発散している悪臭と毒は疫病神すらも逃げ出す程強烈で、実際に撃退したことがある。毒をもって毒を制すとはこのことだろう。
jp_grezzo: "羽の生えた魔力ある蛇神。割と小柄で、５ｍ程度しかない。体から発散している悪臭と毒は疫病神すらも逃げ出す程強烈で、実際に撃退したことがある。毒をもって毒を制すとはこのことだろう。"
en: A feathered and magical serpent god. It is relatively small only about 5 meters long. The stench and poison that is emanating from the body is so strong that even the pestilence god runs away and has actually been repelled. This is what it means to conquer poison with poison isn't it?
en_grezzo: "A feathered and magical serpent god. It is relatively small only about 5 meters long. The stench and poison that is emanating from the body is so strong that even the pestilence god runs away and has actually been repelled. This is what it means to conquer poison with poison isn't it?"
it: Un serpente divino, alato e pieno di potere magico. È piuttosto minuto: non arriva ai 5 metri. Il fetore e il veleno che gli escono dal corpo sono così violenti da mettere in fuga perfino il dio della pestilenza, e una volta è successo davvero. Ecco che cosa vuol dire vincere il veleno col veleno.

jp: 石のように重い声で鳴く蛇。よって鳴蛇。4枚の翼を持ち、水中に巣を作る。水源地を占拠したり雲の中の水分を吸ったりするため、天敵のいない地域ではかんばつが起きる。
jp_grezzo: "石のように重い声で鳴く蛇。よって鳴蛇。4枚の翼を持ち、水中に巣を作る。水源地を占拠したり雲の中の水分を吸ったりするため、天敵のいない地域ではかんばつが起きる。"
en: A snake with a voice as heavy as stone. They have four wings and build a nest in the water. As they occupy water source areas and absorb moisture in the clouds drought occurs in areas without natural enemies.
en_grezzo: "A snake with a voice as heavy as stone. They have four wings and build a nest in the water. As they occupy water source areas and absorb moisture in the clouds drought occurs in areas without natural enemies."
it: Un serpente che stride con una voce pesante come la pietra: di qui il suo nome. Ha quattro ali e fa il nido sott'acqua. Occupa le sorgenti e succhia via l'acqua dentro le nuvole, e così dove non ha nemici naturali arriva la siccità.

jp: キッカス原産の蛇でその体長は20ｍ程度にもなる。毒はないが締めつける力が強く、馬や熊が絞殺される。ペットとして連れてこられたものが飼い主を食い殺して脱走し増殖、今日では世界中で家畜を襲っている。
jp_grezzo: "キッカス原産の蛇でその体長は20ｍ程度にもなる。毒はないが締めつける力が強く、馬や熊が絞殺される。ペットとして連れてこられたものが飼い主を食い殺して脱走し増殖、今日では世界中で家畜を襲っている。"
en: This snake is native to Kikkas and its body can be as long as 20 meters. It's not poisonous but it's a tightening force and it strangles horses and bears. Those brought in as pets devour their owners escape and multiply and today attack livestock all over the world.
en_grezzo: "This snake is native to Kikkas and its body can be as long as 20 meters. It's not poisonous but it's a tightening force and it strangles horses and bears. Those brought in as pets devour their owners escape and multiply and today attack livestock all over the world."
it: Un serpente originario di Kikkasu, che arriva a una ventina di metri di lunghezza. Veleno non ne ha, ma stringe con una forza tale da strangolare cavalli e orsi. Quelli portati via come animali da compagnia si sono mangiati il padrone, sono scappati e si sono moltiplicati, e oggi assaltano il bestiame in tutto il mondo.

jp: 地獄の泥から作られたゴーレム。力が強くて普通に危険なのだが、地獄の冷気をまとっており掠っただけでも生気を吸い取られてしまう。あの世に送られた邪悪な魔術師が生み出したとされる。
jp_grezzo: "地獄の泥から作られたゴーレム。力が強くて普通に危険なのだが、地獄の冷気をまとっており掠っただけでも生気を吸い取られてしまう。あの世に送られた邪悪な魔術師が生み出したとされる。"
en: A golem made from the mud of hell. It is powerful and normally dangerous but it is covered with the cold air of hell and even if it is grazed its life will be lost. It is said to have been created by an evil sorcerer sent to the other world.
en_grezzo: "A golem made from the mud of hell. It is powerful and normally dangerous but it is covered with the cold air of hell and even if it is grazed its life will be lost. It is said to have been created by an evil sorcerer sent to the other world."
it: Un golem fatto col fango dell'inferno. È forte, e già così sarebbe pericoloso, ma per giunta è avvolto nel gelo infernale: basta che ti sfiori e ti succhia via il soffio vitale. Si dice che l'abbia creato un mago malvagio spedito nell'aldilà.

jp: 強靭な筋肉の塊。構造・成り立ちから間違いなくゴーレムに分類され、人造人間などとはまた趣が異なる。筋肉の維持に生物を取り込む必要があるのだが、他生物の遺伝子が混ざりすぎると暴走してしまう。
jp_grezzo: "強靭な筋肉の塊。構造・成り立ちから間違いなくゴーレムに分類され、人造人間などとはまた趣が異なる。筋肉の維持に生物を取り込む必要があるのだが、他生物の遺伝子が混ざりすぎると暴走してしまう。"
en: A mass of strong muscle. It is definitely categorized as a golem because of its structure and composition and it has a different flavor from an artificial person. They need to take the organism in to maintain their muscles but if the genes of other organisms get mixed in too much they run amok.
en_grezzo: "A mass of strong muscle. It is definitely categorized as a golem because of its structure and composition and it has a different flavor from an artificial person. They need to take the organism in to maintain their muscles but if the genes of other organisms get mixed in too much they run amok."
it: Un ammasso di muscoli tenacissimi. Per come è fatto e per come è nato va senza dubbio contato fra i golem, ed è tutt'altra cosa dagli uomini artificiali. Per mantenere i muscoli deve inglobare altri esseri viventi, ma se i geni degli altri si mescolano troppo perde il controllo e si scatena.

jp: 10月になると仮装して他所のお宅に現れる。「辺境の家ほど珍しいお菓子がある」という謎の噂が子供たちの間で広がっており、僻地が逆に人気の模様。かなり本気度の高い仮装で有名。
jp_grezzo: "10月になると仮装して他所のお宅に現れる。「辺境の家ほど珍しいお菓子がある」という謎の噂が子供たちの間で広がっており、僻地が逆に人気の模様。かなり本気度の高い仮装で有名。"
en: On the 10th month they appear at other people's houses in costume. A mysterious rumor is spreading among children that there are more rare treats than a frontier house and it seems that the frontier is becoming more popular in turn. They are famous for their rather serious fancy dress.
en_grezzo: "On the 10th month they appear at other people's houses in costume. A mysterious rumor is spreading among children that there are more rare treats than a frontier house and it seems that the frontier is becoming more popular in turn. They are famous for their rather serious fancy dress."
it: Quando arriva ottobre si traveste e si presenta a casa d'altri. Fra i bambini gira una voce misteriosa, che più la casa è sperduta più i dolci sono rari, e così le zone fuori mano sono diventate le più ambite. È famoso per travestimenti fatti con una serietà notevole.

jp: 10月になると仮装して他所のお宅に現れる。怖いもの知らずであり、お菓子のためなら魔物の群れも突っ切り、冒険者の家にも飛び込む。とてつもない執念深さを恐れて居留守を使う家庭も多い。
jp_grezzo: "10月になると仮装して他所のお宅に現れる。怖いもの知らずであり、お菓子のためなら魔物の群れも突っ切り、冒険者の家にも飛び込む。とてつもない執念深さを恐れて居留守を使う家庭も多い。"
en: On the 10th month they appear at other people's houses in costume. They are fearless and will fight through a pack of demons for sweets even jumping into the homes of adventurers. There are many families who fear that they will be extremely vindictive.
en_grezzo: "On the 10th month they appear at other people's houses in costume. They are fearless and will fight through a pack of demons for sweets even jumping into the homes of adventurers. There are many families who fear that they will be extremely vindictive."
it: Quando arriva ottobre si traveste e si presenta a casa d'altri. Non conosce paura: per un dolce attraversa un branco di mostri e si butta perfino dentro casa di un avventuriero. Molte famiglie ne temono l'ostinazione smisurata e fanno finta di non essere in casa.

jp: 遺跡から発見された量産型の恐竜メカ。解析したところ、ジラをモデルとして作られたことが判明した。パワーはあるが格闘戦は苦手で、ホバー能力を用いて距離を取り、砲撃戦を展開する。
jp_grezzo: "遺跡から発見された量産型の恐竜メカ。解析したところ、ジラをモデルとして作られたことが判明した。パワーはあるが格闘戦は苦手で、ホバー能力を用いて距離を取り、砲撃戦を展開する。"
en: A mass-produced dinosaur mecha that was discovered in the ruins. Analysis revealed that it was built with Zilla as a model. He has power but is not good at fighting and uses his hover ability to gain distance and engage in gunfights.
en_grezzo: "A mass-produced dinosaur mecha that was discovered in the ruins. Analysis revealed that it was built with Zilla as a model. He has power but is not good at fighting and uses his hover ability to gain distance and engage in gunfights."
it: Un dinosauro meccanico di serie, ritrovato fra le rovine. Analizzandolo si è scoperto che l'hanno costruito prendendo a modello lo zilla. La potenza ce l'ha, ma il corpo a corpo non fa per lui: si alza da terra per tenere le distanze e apre il fuoco da lontano.

jp: 数十ｍサイズの霧状の怪物。肉食性であり、普段は雲に擬態して船などを襲っている。捕食の際には体の一部を固体化させ、口などの器官を作り出す。
jp_grezzo: "数十ｍサイズの霧状の怪物。肉食性であり、普段は雲に擬態して船などを襲っている。捕食の際には体の一部を固体化させ、口などの器官を作り出す。"
en: A foggy monster several tens of meters in size. It is carnivorous and usually mimics a cloud to attack ships. During predation it solidifies parts of its body and produces organs such as its mouth.
en_grezzo: "A foggy monster several tens of meters in size. It is carnivorous and usually mimics a cloud to attack ships. During predation it solidifies parts of its body and produces organs such as its mouth."
it: Un mostro fatto di nebbia, grande alcune decine di metri. È carnivoro, e di solito si finge nuvola per assalire le navi e simili. Quando divora si solidifica una parte del corpo e si fabbrica una bocca e gli altri organi che gli servono.

jp: 百ｍ前後もの体長を持つ巨大で細長い生物。不可視の存在。旺盛な食欲で大地を食らい、他の星を死滅させたこともある。イルヴァではギガモールという天敵がおり、たまらず地上へ逃げてくることが多い。
jp_grezzo: "百ｍ前後もの体長を持つ巨大で細長い生物。不可視の存在。旺盛な食欲で大地を食らい、他の星を死滅させたこともある。イルヴァではギガモールという天敵がおり、たまらず地上へ逃げてくることが多い。"
en: A huge slender creature with a body length of around one hundred meters. An invisible presence. It has devoured the earth with its voracious appetite and has even killed other stars. In Irva there is a natural enemy called Gigamor and it often runs away to the ground in desperation.
en_grezzo: "A huge slender creature with a body length of around one hundred meters. An invisible presence. It has devoured the earth with its voracious appetite and has even killed other stars. In Irva there is a natural enemy called Gigamor and it often runs away to the ground in desperation."
it: Un essere enorme e affusolato, lungo attorno ai cento metri. Alla vista non c'è. Con la sua fame smisurata divora la terra, e altri pianeti li ha già fatti morire. A Irva però ha un nemico naturale, la talpa colossale, e spesso non ce la fa più e scappa in superficie.

jp: 神、悪魔、地霊などの側面を持つ妖怪だが元々は人間。鬼の中でも上位の存在。自らでも抑えきれないほどの高い魔力を持ち、体から漏れる魔力が「輝き」を放つ。
jp_grezzo: "神、悪魔、地霊などの側面を持つ妖怪だが元々は人間。鬼の中でも上位の存在。自らでも抑えきれないほどの高い魔力を持ち、体から漏れる魔力が「輝き」を放つ。"
en: They are originally human though they have aspects such as gods demons and earth spirits. It is a high ranking among the demons. It possesses a high level of magical power that is uncontrollable even by itself and the magical power leaking from its body gives off a glow.
en_grezzo: "They are originally human though they have aspects such as gods demons and earth spirits. It is a high ranking among the demons. It possesses a high level of magical power that is uncontrollable even by itself and the magical power leaking from its body gives off a glow."
it: Una creatura soprannaturale che ha lati da dio, da demone e da spirito della terra, ma in origine era un uomo. Fra i suoi simili sta in alto. Ha un potere magico così grande che nemmeno lui riesce a contenerlo, e quello che gli trabocca dal corpo manda un bagliore.

jp: 神、悪魔、地霊などの側面を持つ妖怪だが元々は人間。クールで冷静だが荒々しい衝動を秘めている。力と技をあわせ持ち、刃物の扱いに長け、邪魔するものを「切裂き」排除する。
jp_grezzo: "神、悪魔、地霊などの側面を持つ妖怪だが元々は人間。クールで冷静だが荒々しい衝動を秘めている。力と技をあわせ持ち、刃物の扱いに長け、邪魔するものを「切裂き」排除する。"
en: They are originally human though they have aspects such as gods demons and earth spirits. They're cool and calm but they have wild impulses. They possess a combination of strength and skill and are skilled with blades and can cut through anything that gets in their way.
en_grezzo: "They are originally human though they have aspects such as gods demons and earth spirits. They're cool and calm but they have wild impulses. They possess a combination of strength and skill and are skilled with blades and can cut through anything that gets in their way."
it: Una creatura soprannaturale che ha lati da dio, da demone e da spirito della terra, ma in origine era un uomo. È freddo e pacato, ma dentro nasconde impulsi violenti. Mette insieme la forza e la tecnica, è maestro nel maneggiare le lame, e chi gli si mette in mezzo lo squarta e lo toglie di torno.

jp: 神、悪魔、地霊などの側面を持つ妖怪だが元々は人間。荒々しい性格で非常に力も強く、邪魔するものを粉々に「砕き」排除する。人と意気投合し、親しくなることもある。
jp_grezzo: "神、悪魔、地霊などの側面を持つ妖怪だが元々は人間。荒々しい性格で非常に力も強く、邪魔するものを粉々に「砕き」排除する。人と意気投合し、親しくなることもある。"
en: They were originally human though they have aspects such as gods demons and earth spirits. They have a rugged personality and are extremely powerful shattering and eliminating anything that gets in their way. It is possible to hit it off with them and get to know them well.
en_grezzo: "They were originally human though they have aspects such as gods demons and earth spirits. They have a rugged personality and are extremely powerful shattering and eliminating anything that gets in their way. It is possible to hit it off with them and get to know them well."
it: Una creatura soprannaturale che ha lati da dio, da demone e da spirito della terra, ma in origine era un uomo. Ha un carattere rude ed è fortissimo: chi gli si mette in mezzo lo frantuma in mille pezzi e lo toglie di torno. Ogni tanto però si trova bene con qualcuno e ci fa amicizia.

jp: より戦闘に特化したエイリアン。過去に寄生した生物の遺伝子を取り込んでおり、知能、身体能力ともに普通のエイリアンとは比べ物にならない。酸性の粘液を積極的に武器として用いる。
jp_grezzo: "より戦闘に特化したエイリアン。過去に寄生した生物の遺伝子を取り込んでおり、知能、身体能力ともに普通のエイリアンとは比べ物にならない。酸性の粘液を積極的に武器として用いる。"
en: An alien that specializes more in combat. It has taken in the genes of a parasitic organism from the past and its intelligence and physical abilities are beyond those of ordinary aliens. It actively uses acidic mucus as a weapon.
en_grezzo: "An alien that specializes more in combat. It has taken in the genes of a parasitic organism from the past and its intelligence and physical abilities are beyond those of ordinary aliens. It actively uses acidic mucus as a weapon."
it: Un alieno ancora più specializzato nel combattimento. Si è preso dentro i geni degli esseri che ha parassitato in passato, e per intelligenza e prestanza fisica un alieno comune non gli sta nemmeno vicino. Il suo muco acido lo usa volentieri come arma.

jp: 宇宙のテクノロジーで戦闘用に強化された蟻のような巨大生物。全体的に能力が上昇しているが、甲殻と酸噴出力の強化が著しい。色のせいでステルス性能は下がっているが。
jp_grezzo: "宇宙のテクノロジーで戦闘用に強化された蟻のような巨大生物。全体的に能力が上昇しているが、甲殻と酸噴出力の強化が著しい。色のせいでステルス性能は下がっているが。"
en: An ant-like behemoth that has been enhanced for combat by space technology. Overall ability has been increased with significant enhancements to the shell and acid eruption power. The stealth performance is down though due to the color.
en_grezzo: "An ant-like behemoth that has been enhanced for combat by space technology. Overall ability has been increased with significant enhancements to the shell and acid eruption power. The stealth performance is down though due to the color."
it: Un essere gigantesco simile a una formica, potenziato per il combattimento con la tecnologia dello spazio. Le capacità gli sono cresciute su tutta la linea, ma soprattutto la corazza e la forza con cui schizza l'acido. In compenso, per via del colore, passa inosservato molto meno.

jp: 宇宙のテクノロジーで強化された蜘蛛のような巨大生物。鋼のようなボディと驚異的な跳躍力を持つ。酸を練り混ぜた糸を吐いているが、イルヴァの大気とは相性が悪く、糸が分解され酸だけが飛び散ってしまう。
jp_grezzo: "宇宙のテクノロジーで強化された蜘蛛のような巨大生物。鋼のようなボディと驚異的な跳躍力を持つ。酸を練り混ぜた糸を吐いているが、イルヴァの大気とは相性が悪く、糸が分解され酸だけが飛び散ってしまう。"
en: A spider-like behemoth enhanced by space technology. It has a steel-like body and tremendous jumping power. It spits out a thread of kneaded acid but it is incompatible with Irva's atmosphere so the thread breaks down and only the acid splashes out.
en_grezzo: "A spider-like behemoth enhanced by space technology. It has a steel-like body and tremendous jumping power. It spits out a thread of kneaded acid but it is incompatible with Irva's atmosphere so the thread breaks down and only the acid splashes out."
it: Un essere gigantesco simile a un ragno, potenziato con la tecnologia dello spazio. Ha un corpo che pare d'acciaio e un salto prodigioso. Sputa un filo impastato di acido, ma con l'aria di Irva non va d'accordo: il filo si disfa e resta solo l'acido, che schizza dappertutto.
